entities.summary: Motoshi Fujita (藤田 元司, Fujita Motoshi;  was a Japanese professional baseball pitcher and manager. He spent his entire career with the Yomiuri Giants of Nippon Professional Baseball, winning two Japan Series titles as a player and two more as manager.
